key_idea: The part of the pole inside the tower is half of the whole pole.
steps: The pole goes from 8 m up to 20 m. So it is 20 - 8 = 12 m long.
Half of the pole is inside the tower. Half of 12 is 6.
The pole starts at 8 m and goes 6 m up to the top of the tower: 8 + 6 = 14.

choice_feedback.A: The bottom of the pole is at 8 m, and 6 m of the pole is inside. 8 + 6 = 14, not 10.
choice_feedback.B: 12 m is the length of the whole pole, not the height of the tower.
choice_feedback.D: Check again: the pole is 12 m long, so 6 m is inside the tower.
choice_feedback.E: 28 m comes from adding 20 + 8. The tower is lower than the top of the flag.
